Name: Ryuk Vendor
Author: Arimlaa
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Ryuk, who trades with you for an apple[/size]
[/color]This is an independent mod designed to add a dark and mysterious atmosphere to the Stardew Valley universe. You can now trade with a Shinigami in the secluded corners of Pelican Town and acquire rare items in exchange for apples. Inspired by the Death Note universe, this mod is designed to introduce an entirely new trading mechanic to the in-game economy.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Extract the files from the ZIP file and add them to your mods folder.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Ryuk[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI (Latest version)
Content Patcher
[b]This mod is standalone; it does not require the main Death Note Valley mod.[/b]
